q: Race condition ka sabse accha description kaunsa hai?
options: Jab final result threads ke interleaving order par depend karta hai
Jab ek process doosre ko kill karta hai
explain: Race condition mein shared data ka final result is baat par depend karta hai ki threads kis order mein chale, jaise counter++ mein update kho jaana.

q: Mutex aur semaphore ke beech sabse bada fark kya hai?
options: Mutex sirf kernel mein chalta hai
Mutex ka ownership hota hai, semaphore ka nahi
explain: Mutex ka ownership hota hai: jisne lock kiya wahi unlock kare. Semaphore ek counter hai bina ownership ke, koi bhi wait/signal kar sakta hai.

q: Critical section ke sahi solution ke teen requirements kaun se hain?
explain: Har sahi critical-section solution ko mutual exclusion, progress aur bounded waiting teeno satisfy karne chahiye.

q: Bounded-buffer producer-consumer mein semaphores ki initial values kya hoti hain?
explain: Shuru mein saare N slots khaali hote hain (empty = N), koi bhara nahi (full = 0), aur mutex = 1 buffer ki mutual exclusion ke liye.

q: Dining philosophers problem mein deadlock kab hota hai?
options: Jab har philosopher pehle apna left chopstick uthaye
Jab koi philosopher khaaye hi na
explain: Agar sab ek saath pehle left chopstick uthaa lein to har kisi ke paas ek hai aur sab doosre ka wait karte hain (circular wait) -> deadlock.
